revision_reasoning: The pedestrian swing gate alone meets the target of 10 conflicts per 1000 under nominal conditions (6.7) and under mirror-ignored stress (6.7), but fails under 40% gate non-compliance (22.7). Adding a convex mirror provides defense in depth: the combined package achieves 4.2 nominal, 5.7 when the mirror is ignored, and 14.9 under 40% gate non-compliance — still above target in the worst case. To address the remaining gap under low gate compliance, a sensor-triggered floor warning light can alert pedestrians even if they bypass the gate, and it adds minimal truck delay (0.7 s alone).
